description: A Three.js sphere of 14,000 shader-lit particles breathing with simplex noise, wrapped in a tilted orbit. Pointer parallax, responsive, offscreen-aware.
usage: import { ThreeParticleSphere } from "@/components/design-for-ai/three-particle-sphere";

props.name: colors
props.description: Rim highlight, mid-tone and core colours.

props.name: density
props.description: Particles on desktop; halved under 640px.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed multiplier.

props.name: turbulence
props.description: Noise displacement strength, 0–1.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Tilt toward the pointer.

props.name: ring
props.description: Show the orbiting particle ring.

name: Voice Orb
description: A shader-built AI voice orb with thin-film sheen and a fresnel rim that breathes, listens to your mic, swirls while thinking and pulses word by word as it speaks.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled state. Omit to let the built-in segmented control drive it.

props.name: defaultState
props.description: Starting state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Called when the control or the mic button changes state.

props.name: name
props.description: The assistant’s name, used in the idle caption and labels.

props.name: captions
props.type: { idle?: string; listening?: string; thinking?: string }
props.description: Caption per state. Mic status lines (waiting, blocked, missing) override listening.

props.name: speakingLines
props.description: Lines voiced by the synthetic speech envelope; the caption lights up word by word in sync with the pulses.

props.name: tones
props.type: Partial<Record<VoiceOrbState, { deep?: string; rim?: string; accent?: string }>>
props.default: amber idle, coral listening, teal thinking, honey speaking
props.description: Body, rim and accent colours per state. Blended, never snapped.

props.name: showControls
props.description: Show the state segmented control and the microphone button.

props.name: showCaption
props.description: Show the eyebrow and caption under the orb.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Tilt the orb gently toward the pointer.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root element.

name: Hover Work Index
description: A studio work index in huge display type. On desktop a cover card follows the cursor on springs and tilts with its velocity, while the other rows dim away.

props.name: projects
props.description: year, client, discipline, href, cover art key and accent colour.

props.name: title
props.description: Section title.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Mono label above the title.

props.name: intro
props.description: Short intro beside the title.

props.name: previewLabel
props.description: Chip label on the floating card.
